Coming Soon to Steam!

[h1]N1RV Ann-A[/h1]

Cyberpunk Bartender Action N1RV Ann-A (pronounced simply as Nirvana) is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and life in the dystopian economic bubble.
Coming soon to PC, Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP)

College dropout Mae Borowski returns home to the crumbling former mining town of Possum Springs seeking to resume her aimless former life and reconnect with the friends she left behind. But things aren't the same. Home seems different now and her friends have grown and changed. Leaves are falling and the wind is growing colder. Strange things are happening as the light fades.
Coming soon to PC (JP), Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP), Xbox One (JP)
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 9 Indie Game Corner 9-B43[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/481510/Night_in_the_Woods/


[h1]Astebreed[/h1]
Climb into the cockpit of an otherworldly war machine and fly into battle against a horrifying alien race bent on eradicating humanity to preserve their own civilization.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Croixleur Sigma[/h1]
Wielding magic blades, four girls fight back successive waves of monsters in this exhilarating hack-and-slash action game!
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Will -A Wonderful World-[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
A young girl wakes up, groggy in an unknown room. A talking dog appears before her and she becomes startled by the revelation he tells her: They are gods and it is their duty to change the fate of any humans that ask for their help. Letters appear in the mail and with pen in hand she begins her job.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch (JP) and PlayStation 4 (JP)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/588040/WILL_A_Wonderful_World__WILL/

The Original Soundtrack for La-Mulana 2 has now been released! Relive the ruins with 59 tracks! 
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 5, Konami Booth[/b]

notes.title: Garden Tale Out Now!
notes.content:
Garden Tale is out now on Steam!! 
Grab it now during it's launch sale! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/614530/Garden_Tale/



[h1]Story[/h1]
The Garden Kingdom, a land filled with beautiful gardens. 
One day, the long-undisturbed peace was to be broken, when a certain incident occurred. Zoolians, beasts from the neighboring Zoo Empire launched an attack on Garden. 
You and your friends are the first to react to the crisis as people’s lives are attacked and threatened. But the further you all progress through the battles, and eventually enter the Zoo Empire, you learn that things are not as they appear…

Garden Tale is a Strategy-RPG game where you defend the Garden Kingdom from an invasion from the Zoo Empire.
Build and command a party, each with a unique skill set, to counter the coming attack. The game features a turn-based system based on a grid. Move your units around and take your foes out before they can overthrow you.
But Garden Tale boasts a unique feature that adds to the gameplay. Bonions!
	
Bonions are onion-like plants you will find spread across the map. They originally come from the Garden Kingdom, and are grown for food. However, when under attack, they can also double as a weapon.
Deplete a Bonion’s HP to 0 and it will explode, causing damage to all those around it. Use this to your advantage in battle as you lure enemies into explosive traps.


[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*]A 2.5 simulation strategy RPG.
[*]Adorable characters with a large variety of skills to master.
[*]Multitudes of strategic moves involving Bonions that act like bombs.
[*]An enticing story to discover.[/list]

[url=https://blog.playism-games.com/garden-tale-coming-soon-what-is-a-bonion/]Learn more about Bonions[/url]
[url=https://blog.playism-games.com/garden-tale-coming-soon-introducing-the-skills/]Discover the Skill in-game[/url]

notes.title: Garden Tale Coming Soon – What is a Bonion?
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Garden Tale[/h1]
Garden Tale is a Strategy-RPG game where you defend the Garden Kingdom from the invasion of the Zoo Empire.
The Garden Kingdom, a land filled with beautiful gardens. One day, the long-undisturbed peace was to be broken, when a certain incident occurred. Zoolians, beasts from the neighboring Zoo Empire launched an attack on Garden. You and your friends are the first to react to the crisis as people’s lives are attacked and threatened.

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/614530/extras/s_garden_tale_2_(4).jpg?t=1496283306]

Build a party and command a party, each with a unique skill set, to counter the coming attack. The game features a turn-based system based on a grid. Move your units around and take your foes out before they can overthrow you.
But Garden Tale boasts a unique feature that adds to the gameplay. [b]Bonions![/b]

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/614530/extras/s_bo3.jpg?t=1496283306][img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/614530/extras/s_bo2.jpg?t=1496283306][img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/614530/extras/s_bo4.jpg?t=1496283306][img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/614530/extras/s_bo5.jpg?t=1496283306]


[h1]What is a Bonion?[/h1]
Bonions are onion-like plants you will find spread across the map. They originally come from the Garden Kingdom, and are grown for food. However, when under attack, they can also double as a weapon.
Deplete a Bonion’s HP to 0 and it will explode, causing damage to all those around it. Use this to your advantage in battle as you lure enemies into explosive traps.
There are different types of Bonion’s in Garden Tale, each with their own pattern of explosions. Catching another Bonion in an explosion will cause it to explode too. Use this to create a chain of explosions around the map in a deadly strategy.
However, these explosions will affect you too, get too careless and you may find yourself defeating your own allies.

[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/614530/extras/s_bonion_explosion.jpg?t=1496283306]

Make sure you add Garden Tale to your wishlist!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/614530/Garden_Tale/
